## What this changes

Brief description. Link any related issue (`Closes #123`).

## Type

- [ ] Fix / clarify existing content
- [ ] New concern or checklist item
- [ ] Skill or auditor behavior
- [ ] Docs only

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is **stack-agnostic** and concrete (no framework hard-coded as "the" way).
- [ ] Any checklist item has all four parts: **Principle / Required (build) /
      Audit signals / Failure modes + Severity**.
- [ ] No absolute machine paths (`grep -rn "/Users/" .` is clean).
- [ ] Tested locally: installed into `~/.claude` and exercised the skill or auditor.
- [ ] `DESIGN.md` status/roadmap updated if scope changed.
